nodes.label: escalar-incidencias.yml GitHub Actions cron
nodes.rationale: Fills the gap that Railway has no native cron: a GitHub Actions schedule (*/15 * * * *) calls /api/cron/escalar-incidencias with CRON_SECRET every 15 minutes and fails the workflow (::error + exit 1) on any HTTP status >= 400, giving visible CI alerting instead of a silently-broken escalation cron.
